our_interpretation: Read an earnings miss as quarterly earnings per share below the contemporaneous analyst consensus, comparing figures on the same accounting basis. A revenue or guidance miss alone does not qualify.
Read the predicted reaction as a sharp, broad stock-market selloff accompanied by heightened volatility. NVIDIA shares alone would not establish market-wide panic.
Examine the announcement and the first two full trading sessions afterward. This reaction window is an evaluator choice.
The claim predicts a market response, rather than a particular company financial amount; metric_scope is therefore null.
